subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: What public reset-start policy should OpenClaw support for bare `/new` and `/reset` across chat commands and Gateway `agent`: acknowledgement-only, startup/greeting turn, configurable greeting model, explicit suppression, or a typed combination of these modes?
rationale: This adds compatibility-sensitive config/default behavior and model-routing semantics; automation should not invent a new reset config key or change the shipped acknowledgement default without maintainer intent.

options.title: Define One Reset Policy
options.body: Create a typed reset-start policy that covers acknowledgement-only resets, startup/greeting turns, optional greeting model selection, and docs/tests for both auto-reply and Gateway surfaces.

options.title: Keep Ack-Only Default
options.body: Close or narrow this request by treating current shipped acknowledgement-only behavior as the supported token-saving path and documenting explicit `/new <model>` or `/new <message>` alternatives.

options.title: Split Prompt And Fallthrough Work
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45501 own prompt text and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/77733 own startup-turn restoration, while leaving greeting-model selection deferred.

recommendation.title: Define One Reset Policy
recommendation.body: Create a typed reset-start policy that covers acknowledgement-only resets, startup/greeting turns, optional greeting model selection, and docs/tests for both auto-reply and Gateway surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses current reset command behavior, Gateway reset behavior, and config compatibility, and steipete is the most direct recent reset-contract reviewer/contributor in the evidence.
